group: Is there a tax on converting?
item: Tax on the conversion or the wire itself
meaning: None of the official sources read in this pass imposes a tax on converting RMB or remitting it. The Regulation says current payments and transfers are not restricted; the bank's job is to check documents, including tax evidence.

group: Chinese tax on the underlying money
item: Individual income tax on wages and service income
meaning: Applies to the income when it was earned, not to the transfer. If it was never withheld, the taxpayer must pay it before the bank will accept the tax evidence.

group: Chinese tax on the underlying money
item: Individual income tax on dividends, interest, rent, property-sale gains, incidental income
meaning: Flat-rate categories. For a property sale the tax base is the gain, not the price.

group: Chinese tax on the underlying money
meaning: Interest on savings deposits has been exempt since 9 October 2008.

group: Chinese tax on the underlying money
item: Tax filing for payments above USD 50,000 (对外支付税务备案)
meaning: A filing with the tax office before a single outbound payment above USD 50,000 in listed categories. It is a record the bank checks, not an extra tax. If the filing shows tax is unpaid, the tax office collects it.

item: Exchange spread at Bank of China
meaning: The gap between the bank's selling rate and the midpoint of its buying and selling rates, measured on the 15:30:04 board of 11 November 2026.

item: Outbound wire fee at Bank of China (personal e-banking)
rate_or_amount: 0.1%, min RMB 50, max RMB 260, plus RMB 150 cable
meaning: Charged per wire. The percentage part stops growing once the wire is about USD 39,000.
Charged by banks in the payment chain and by the U.S. bank. Bank of America says an inbound wire may incur $15; the account schedule controls. Actual intermediary charges remain unknown.

item: U.S. income tax on worldwide income
meaning: A U.S. citizen is taxed on worldwide income wherever they live, so income earned in China belongs on the U.S. return for the year it was earned. Chinese tax paid on it may be credited (Form 1116). No source read in this pass taxes the later transfer of the same money, apart from the currency gain in the next row.

item: Currency gain when RMB is converted to USD (26 U.S.C. § 988)
rate_or_amount: Ordinary rate x the gain, if investment or business money; capital-gain rate if the personal-transaction rule applies; see the table by year acquired
meaning: Selling RMB held in a bank deposit is a disposition of nonfunctional currency (26 U.S.C. § 988(c)(1)(C)). Two cases. If the money is investment or business money, the exchange-rate gain is ordinary income (§ 988(a)(1)(A)). If it is the individual's personal transaction, § 988(e)(1) switches the section off: no gain is recognised on a disposition of currency in a personal transaction unless the gain is more than $200 (§ 988(e)(2)), and the IRS says a larger personal gain is reported as a capital gain (Pub. 525). A personal loss is a different question and is not deductible under the ordinary rules.

rate_or_amount: Non-willful ceiling USD 16,536; willful: greater of USD 165,353 or 50% of the account balance
meaning: Required if the total of your foreign accounts exceeded USD 10,000 at any time in the calendar year. No tax is due with it.

rate_or_amount: USD 10,000, plus up to USD 50,000 after IRS notice
meaning: Filed with the tax return above the thresholds (unmarried in the U.S.: more than USD 50,000 at year end or USD 75,000 at any time).

item: Form 3520 for gifts or bequests from a foreign person
rate_or_amount: 5% of the gift per month late, up to 25%
meaning: Required when gifts or bequests from a nonresident alien or foreign estate total more than USD 100,000 in the year. The gift itself is excluded from income; the form reports it.

rate_or_amount: Seizure and forfeiture; civil or criminal penalties
meaning: Required when more than USD 10,000 in cash or monetary instruments crosses the U.S. border, counted per family or group.

item: Moving foreign exchange or capital out in breach of the rules (逃汇)
rate_or_amount: Fine up to 30%; serious cases 30%-100%; criminal liability
meaning: Covers splitting through other people's quotas and deceptive transfers.

item: Buying FX with false or invalid documents (非法套汇)
rate_or_amount: Fine up to 30%; serious cases 30%-100%; criminal liability
meaning: The conversion is reversed and a fine applied.

item: Private buying or selling of foreign exchange
rate_or_amount: Warning, confiscation of gains, fine up to 30%; serious cases 30%-100%; criminal liability
meaning: Money changers, swaps between individuals, underground banks.

item: Carrying foreign currency across the border in breach of the rules
meaning: For example more than USD 10,000 without a SAFE permit.

item: Watch list (关注名单) for lending or borrowing quotas
meaning: Listed for the year of listing and the next two years; during that time every conversion needs transaction documents.
